description: Fortanix Self-Defending Key Management Service (SDKMS) is the world's first cloud service secured with Intel® SGX. With SDKMS, you can securely generate, store and use cryptographic keys & certificates, as well as secrets, such as passwords, API keys or tokens. It provides access control to users & applications to enforce authorized access to keys.
